name: eberron-dm
description: Eberron-default Dungeon Master assistant for running persistent D&D 5e campaigns entirely on the local filesystem. Campaign creation/loading, character management, combat tracking, NPC generation, dice rolling, XP/encounter budgeting, a deterministic campaign graph, and full session state persisted across sessions under ~/eberron-dnd. Ships a bundled canonical Eberron lorebook (distilled references + full-text corpus) searchable offline via lore_search.py, plus the 5e SRD (2014) for instant rules/monster/spell lookup. No display companion, no network, no external services. Provides the `dnd` skill; invoke as /dm:dnd, or just describe what you want once a campaign is loaded.
